scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w @nail-online/server" "npm run dev -w @nail-online/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nail-online/web && npm run check -w @nail-online/server
scripts.check: npm run check -w @nail-online/shared && npm run check -w @nail-online/server && npm run check -w @nail-online/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nail-online/server && npm run test -w @nail-online/web
